name: Founders' Covenant Day
description: A mandatory full-day holiday across all GLMZ corponation facilities, commemorating the 2183 signing of the Meridian Compact — the founding charter agreement between seven corponations that formalized the megacity's governance structure. Officially a celebration of 'civic cooperation and shared prosperity,' the holiday involves mandated workplace ceremonies, loyalty recitations, and company-branded gift distributions. Internally, compliance officers track which employees attend optional 'covenant renewal' events, and the data affects performance reviews.
cultural_impact: Founders' Covenant Day is the most universally observed holiday in GLMZ precisely because non-observance carries professional consequences — it has normalized the fusion of civic identity with corporate loyalty to a degree that most Tier 3 and above residents no longer consciously notice. On the Gray Zone, it is observed with elaborate irony.
key_figures: The Seven Founders (historical corporate signatories, now mythologized)
Director Amara Solís-Bergström (current Compact Authority chair)
Founders' Ghost (anonymous Underworld satirist who publishes annual 'alternative histories' of the signing)
locations: Compact Spire, Tier 4-5 border (official ceremony site)
Meridian Civic Broadcast Network (mandatory workplace viewing)
Founders' Ash Market, the Gray Zone Ward 3 (ironic underground counter-celebration)
story_hooks: Founders' Ghost has announced they will release the actual unredacted text of the 2183 Compact this year — the version that was never made public — and the corponations are quietly moving to find and silence them before the holiday.

A player character is assigned to provide security at the official Compact Spire ceremony and discovers the keynote speaker has been replaced at the last minute with someone whose identity they cannot verify through any database.

the Gray Zone's Founders' Ash Market this year has a vendor selling what they claim are authenticated fragments of the original Compact document — and someone very powerful wants them acquired or destroyed before the day is out.
origin_event: The February 7, 2183 signing of the Meridian Compact by representatives of Axiom-Dyne, Veridian Corp, Helix Infrastructure, Solaris Media Group, NovaBio Systems, Cascade Logistics, and the Helios Municipal Authority, formally establishing the megacity's corponation governance framework.
tier_observations: Tier 1 residents hold the Founders' Ash Market — a ghost market where everything is sold under ironic Compact-themed names, and the day is treated as a dark comedy. Tier 2 workers attend mandatory workplace ceremonies with visible disengagement, accept the branded gift packages (usually a food voucher and a company-logo item), and go home. Tier 3 employees treat it as a genuine civic occasion mixed with nervousness about covenant renewal attendance tracking. Tier 4 attends elaborate corporate galas with genuine enthusiasm or performed enthusiasm indistinguishable from it. Tier 5 Spire residents host private dinners echoing the original 2183 signing banquet, with considerable self-congratulation.
